movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.description: A banker sentenced to life in prison forms an unlikely friendship and finds hope through acts of decency and perseverance over two decades.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.description: A masked vigilante battles a criminal mastermind who plunges an entire city into chaos with his twisted schemes and moral dilemmas.

movies.title: Inception
movies.description: A skilled thief who steals secrets from within people's dreams is offered a chance to have his criminal record erased if he can plant an idea in someone's subconscious.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.description: The aging patriarch of a powerful crime dynasty transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son amid betrayal and violence.

movies.title: Forrest Gump
movies.description: A kind-hearted man with a low IQ accidentally influences several historical events in the 20th century while pursuing his one true love.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.description: A computer hacker discovers that reality as he knows it is a simulation created by machines, and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new habitable planet as Earth faces an agricultural crisis threatening humanity's survival.

movies.title: The Lion King
movies.description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after the murder of his father, only to return years later to reclaim his rightful throne.

movies.title: Titanic
movies.description: A young aristocratic woman falls in love with a poor artist aboard a doomed luxury ocean liner on its maiden voyage across the Atlantic.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.description: Scientists visit a theme park of cloned dinosaurs created by a billionaire, but things go horribly wrong when the prehistoric creatures escape their enclosures.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.description: A betrayed Roman general is enslaved and rises through the ranks of gladiatorial combat to avenge the murder of his family and emperor.

movies.title: Finding Nemo
movies.description: An overprotective clownfish embarks on a perilous journey across the ocean to rescue his son who was captured by a scuba diver.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.description: Earth's mightiest superheroes must come together to stop an alien army and a trickster god from conquering the planet.

movies.title: Schindler's List
movies.description: A German businessman saves the lives of over a thousand Jewish refugees during the Holocaust by employing them in his factories.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.description: The interconnected stories of criminals, a boxer, and a pair of philosophical hitmen unfold in a nonlinear narrative filled with dark humor.

movies.title: WALL-E
movies.description: A small waste-collecting robot on an abandoned Earth discovers a living plant and follows a sleek probe robot into outer space, sparking an adventure to save humanity.

movies.title: The Martian
movies.description: An astronaut is stranded alone on Mars after a storm and must use his ingenuity and botanical skills to survive until a rescue mission can reach him.

movies.title: Coco
movies.description: A young boy journeys to the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary musician, and discover the truth about his family's history.

movies.title: Rocky
movies.description: A small-time boxer from Philadelphia gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot at the world heavyweight championship and must train harder than ever before.

movies.title: Jaws
movies.description: A coastal town is terrorized by a massive great white shark during the peak summer season, forcing the police chief, a marine biologist, and a grizzled fisherman to hunt it down.

movies.title: Up
movies.description: An elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America to fulfill a promise to his late wife, accidentally bringing along an eager young scout.

movies.title: Gravity
movies.description: Two astronauts are stranded in orbit after their space shuttle is destroyed by debris, struggling to survive with dwindling oxygen and no communication with Earth.

movies.title: The Social Network
movies.description: The founding of a social media empire leads to legal battles and broken friendships as a brilliant but socially awkward programmer builds the world's largest network.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.description: In a post-apocalyptic desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebellious war captain join forces to flee a tyrannical warlord and his army in a high-speed chase.

movies.title: Inside Out
movies.description: The personified emotions inside a young girl's mind struggle to help her cope when her family moves to a new city and everything feels unfamiliar.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.description: A poor family schemes their way into becoming employed by a wealthy household, leading to unexpected consequences that blur the lines between social classes.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.description: An ambitious young jazz drummer enrolls at a cutthroat conservatory where a ruthless instructor will stop at nothing to realize his student's potential.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.description: A jazz musician and an aspiring actress fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles, facing the difficult choice between love and ambition.

movies.title: The Revenant

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.description: A cowboy doll feels threatened when a flashy new space ranger action figure arrives and competes for the affection of their child owner.

movies.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
movies.description: The story of rock band Queen and their legendary lead singer, tracing his life from forming the band to their iconic performance at Live Aid.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.description: A linguist is recruited by the military to communicate with alien visitors who have landed in massive spacecraft around the world, racing to understand their language before global tensions escalate.

movies.title: When Harry Met Sally
movies.description: Two college graduates share a series of chance encounters over the years in New York City, debating whether men and women can truly be just friends.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.description: A young man visits his girlfriend's family estate and discovers a disturbing secret that reveals a horrifying conspiracy beneath their seemingly welcoming facade.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

movies.title: The Silence of the Lambs
movies.description: A young FBI trainee seeks the help of an imprisoned cannibalistic serial killer to catch another serial killer who is on the loose.

movies.title: Frozen

movies.title: The Prestige

movies.title: 12 Angry Men
movies.description: A single juror gradually persuades the others to reconsider the evidence in a murder trial that initially seemed open and shut.

movies.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
movies.description: After a painful breakup, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to erase each other from their memories, only to rediscover their connection.

movies.title: Dunkirk

movies.title: Ratatouille
movies.description: A rat with a passion for cooking forms an unlikely alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Parisian restaurant to pursue his culinary dreams.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.description: A new blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that could plunge what remains of society into chaos, leading him on a quest to find a former blade runner who has been missing for decades.

movies.title: The Departed
movies.description: An undercover cop infiltrates a crime syndicate while a mole within the police feeds information to the same criminal organization, and both sides race to uncover the other.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.description: A young girl enters a mysterious world of spirits and must work in a magical bathhouse to free her parents who have been transformed into pigs.

movies.title: Moneyball
movies.description: A baseball team's general manager uses data analytics and statistics to assemble a competitive team on a limited budget, challenging traditional scouting methods.

movies.title: Her
movies.description: A lonely writer develops a romantic relationship with an advanced artificial intelligence operating system designed to adapt and evolve.
Two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory to deliver a message that could save 1,600 men from walking into a deadly trap during World War I.

movies.title: Zootopia
movies.description: A rookie bunny cop teams up with a sly fox con artist to uncover a conspiracy involving missing predators in a city of anthropomorphic animals.
